title: Thursday's boring SaaS, 2 October 2026
dek: Hello. Here's revenue notes on 10 products for 2 October 2026. All 10 are Stripe-verified, and each one links to the source.

companies.name: Fast Corp Ltd
companies.description: All-in-one Bulgarian EU company launch + ongoing compliance. Online EOOD/OOD formation in ~3–5 business days (formation from ~€1,500–€1,750), then optional bookkeeping/VAT/payroll (accounting from ~€229/mo). EU IBAN/banking support, virtual office, 10% corporate tax pitch. Bootstrapped, Sofia, team 2–5, ~3,000 clients claimed since 2018.
companies.evidence: ~$8.6k L30, ~$56k all-time, MRR not listed as seat subscriptions (formation + service mix). Founded Jul 2025 on TrustMRR profile (ops claim longer history), Bulgaria. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Pick one low-tax / high-bureaucracy EU (or LatAm) jurisdiction and sell remote incorporation + bookkeeping as a productized firm. Switching costs explode once VAT and payroll live there.
companies.whyItPrints: Same shape as LegalOne (FR legal notices) and Khosmos (FR trade invoicing): own one country's mandatory admin stack. Formation is a high-ticket front door; monthly accounting is the sticky recurring layer. Entrepreneurs pay to avoid lawyers and tax chaos.

companies.name: Liinks
companies.description: Link-in-bio / multi-link landing pages for creators and brand teams — customize, auto-pull Instagram links, track clicks. Starter ~$5/mo, Pro ~$12/mo. US, founded 2020.
companies.evidence: ~$31.2k MRR, 5,419 active subscriptions, ~$32.7k L30, ~$1.76M all-time, ~10,000 users claimed, founded May 2020, US. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Own a thin, high-volume creator utility (link page, media kit, tipping page) with cheap seats and brutal retention via habit.
companies.whyItPrints: Linktree-shaped infra with real Stripe scale: thousands of paying subs and $1.7M+ all-time. Unsexy "one URL for everything" plumbing that creators renew without thinking.

companies.name: Pasul.ro
companies.description: Romanian mental-health marketplace matching clients (Romania + diaspora) with vetted Romanian-speaking psychologists/therapists for online or in-person sessions. Free 15-min discovery call, secure payments, ~219 RON average per session. Founded late 2024, Romania.
companies.evidence: ~$30.6k L30, ~$306k all-time, MRR listed without active seat count (session marketplace). ~2,000 users claimed, founded Dec 2024, Romania. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Match diaspora patients to same-language clinicians in one country (therapy, dentistry, physio). Trust + language is the moat; payments + matching are the product.
companies.whyItPrints: Country + language vertical healthcare marketplace — Calendesk cousin for therapy demand, not therapist SaaS. Transaction volume (~$30k L30) without seat MRR means take-rate on sessions, not subscriptions.

companies.name: uhoh.com
companies.description: Flat-fee managed IT help desk / MSP for growing startups — "priced by you," free to try, subscriptions starting ~$3k/mo (up to ~50 staff). Canada-founded, mid-2025.
companies.evidence: ~$36.4k MRR, 30 active subscriptions, ~$32.8k L30, ~$417k all-time, founded Jun 2025, Canada. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Productize a service niche (IT desk, bookkeeping, SOC monitoring) with flat monthly pricing and a simple intake portal — sell outcomes, not tickets.
companies.whyItPrints: Selling outsourced IT ops as a productized MSP with transparent Stripe billing. Tiny sub count (30) × high ACV = real print; classic boring B2B services wrapped as SaaS-ish recurring.

companies.name: Angel Match
companies.description: Searchable database of ~124k–125k angel investors and VCs for founders raising seed. Freemium + paid subscription. US, founded 2019.
companies.evidence: ~$24.8k MRR, 311 active subscriptions, ~$28.4k L30, ~$961k all-time, ~125,000 users claimed, founded Jan 2019, US. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Own a niche contact graph (angels, procurement buyers, clinic GMs) with enrichment + filters. Data freshness is the retention hook.
companies.whyItPrints: Data directory SaaS — scrape/enrich once, charge annually for access. Nearly $1M all-time and ~$25k MRR with hundreds of subs; founders will keep paying while fundraising.

companies.name: V62Form
companies.description: UK DVLA V62 helper — fill/print/ship the form to get a replacement V5C vehicle registration certificate (logbook) when lost, stolen, damaged, or missing after purchase. Free download / Print & Ship ~£11.95 / Complete Service ~£39.95. UK, founded 2025.
companies.evidence: ~$33.8k all-time, MRR listed as none (pay-per-form). ~5,000 users claimed, founded Mar 2025, UK. Last sync Oct 2, 2026. (L30 not prominently listed on card; all-time is the solid signal.)
companies.indieAngle: Wrap one painful DVLA / DMV / registry form with guided UX + print/ship. Expand form-by-form once SEO works.
companies.whyItPrints: Pure government-form glue (car-docs.ro / Easy Moving Permits lane). Transaction revenue, no seat MRR — people pay once to dodge Post Office queues and paperwork anxiety.

companies.name: Karma
companies.description: Employee recognition & rewards bot for Slack and Microsoft Teams — public/private kudos, analytics, gift-card rewards. ~$3/user/mo. NZ-listed on TrustMRR; G2 ~4.9.
companies.evidence: ~$6.1k MRR, 263 active subscriptions, ~$24.5k L30, ~$725k all-time, ~14,000 users claimed, founded Jan 2024, New Zealand. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Build one Slack/Teams utility HR will budget for (recognition, PTO, standups, on-call) and charge per active seat.
companies.whyItPrints: Workplace Slack apps that sit in the chat and meter seats. L30 (~$25k) far above seat-MRR (~$6k) suggests annual plans / rewards top-ups — still ~$725k all-time verified.

companies.name: Enquiry Genie
companies.description: Chrome extension that drafts Airbnb/direct-booking enquiry replies in the host's tone with live pricing & availability (Gmail/Outlook + iCal/Airbnb sync). £1 for 14 days, then ~£29/mo for up to 5 properties. UK, bootstrapped.
companies.evidence: ~$9.4k L30, ~$353k all-time, MRR listed as none / no active subscriptions. ~54 users claimed on profile, founded Apr 2025, UK. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Automate the repetitive guest/host (or clinic/patient) email that already has structured data (calendar + price). Stay in inbox; charge per property/location.
companies.whyItPrints: Narrow ops automation for hosts drowning in the same email. Strong all-time (~$353k) with "no active subscriptions" on the MRR field — treat L30/all-time as the print signal (usage/mixed billing pattern, like Helios/MedPilot).

companies.name: Guidejar
companies.description: Interactive product demos / how-to guides / internal docs — record a process (Chrome or desktop), edit, AI voiceover/translate, share or embed; help-center hosting. Free up to 5 guides; paid unlimited. India-founded, ~10k users claimed.
companies.evidence: ~$5.0k MRR, 215 active subscriptions, ~$5.5k L30, ~$145k all-time, ~10,000 users claimed, founded Jul 2023, India. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Capture → shareable guide for one workflow type (onboarding, SOPs, feature tours). Free tier as SEO funnel; seats/workspaces as upgrade.
companies.whyItPrints: Supademo-adjacent documentation infra. Teams buy so support stops screen-sharing the same flow — ~$5k MRR and ~$145k all-time with hundreds of subs.

companies.name: Aila
companies.description: Agentic AI for US mortgage teams — intake/compliance agents that listen to discovery calls, build the loan file in LOS/CRM (ARIVE, LendingPad, etc.), request docs, score compliance. From ~$50/LO/mo (intake+compliance); enterprise ~$200/LO/mo. Homepage also at withaila.com.
companies.evidence: ~$18.1k MRR, 99 active subscriptions, ~$18.7k L30, ~$116k all-time, ~100 users claimed, founded Nov 2023, US. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Own one regulated sales call → system-of-record pipeline (mortgage, insurance, wealth). Charge per producer; integrate the LOS they already live in.
companies.whyItPrints: Vertical workflow glue for loan officers (not a general chatbot). Clear ACV per LO, ~99 paying seats, sticky once wired into LOS — Conductor-shaped but for mortgage ops instead of QuickBooks Desktop.
